source: Eruption of Mount St. Helens, 1980 (USDA Forest Service film, 1986), National Archives and Records Administration, ARC 13364 / local ID 95.68
credit_line: USDA Forest Service film (1986), via National Archives · public domain
note: The film mixes documentary footage, reenactments and interviews and does not label shot dates. Only aerial and landscape shots without people are used, and none is described as showing a specific moment.

msh-crater.shows: aerial view of the summit crater with fractures

msh-plume-far.shows: a plume rising from the summit, seen from a distance, aerial

msh-column.shows: close view of a billowing ash column

msh-river-ash.shows: aerial view of a river valley under ash cloud, helicopter overhead

msh-bridge-flood.shows: a bridge and flooded river carrying debris

msh-eruption-seq.shows: an eruption cloud building over the summit, seen from a distance

msh-aerial-column.shows: aerial view of a dense ash column
